sections.title: MLA Proseminar: Chinese Poetry & Prose
sections.description: A wide variety of poetic & prose genres from the earliest times to the 19th century is introduced through English translation. A few selections will also be studied in Chinese characters with romanized transcriptions. There are no prerequisites for this course.
